english: The hospital's billing office confirmed this bill using a code sent to its official email.
swahili: Ofisi ya malipo ya hospitali imethibitisha bili hii kwa msimbo uliotumwa kwa barua pepe rasmi ya hospitali.

english: The family has shared a bill. We are waiting for the hospital to confirm it. Donations are not paid out yet.
swahili: Familia imeshiriki bili. Tunasubiri hospitali iithibitishe. Michango bado haijalipwa.

english: This bill has not been checked by the hospital. Be careful and do not send money outside TibaDirect.
swahili: Bili hii haijakaguliwa na hospitali. Kuwa mwangalifu na usitume pesa nje ya TibaDirect.

english: Please try again. If it keeps happening, contact us and mention the reference below.
swahili: Tafadhali jaribu tena. Likiendelea, wasiliana nasi na utaje namba ya rejea hapa chini.

english: We could not reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
swahili: Hatukuweza kufikia huduma. Angalia mtandao wako kisha ujaribu tena.

english: Too many tries. Please wait {{seconds}} seconds and try again.
swahili: Umejaribu mara nyingi. Tafadhali subiri sekunde {{seconds}} kisha ujaribu tena.

english: When you give, you choose what should happen if more money arrives than the bill needs, or the treatment ends sooner than planned.
swahili: Unapotoa, unachagua kitakachotokea ikiwa pesa nyingi kuliko bili zinahitajika zitafika, au matibabu yakiisha mapema kuliko ilivyopangwa.

english: Your share goes back to you through PayPal. Leftovers under $1 go to the solidarity pool instead, because the refund would cost more than it returns.
swahili: Sehemu yako inarudishwa kwako kupitia PayPal. Salio chini ya $1 huenda kwenye mfuko wa mshikamano, kwa sababu kurudisha kungegharimu zaidi ya kinachorudishwa.

english: Your share goes into a shared solidarity pool. The transfer is written in the public ledger like any other movement.
swahili: Sehemu yako inaenda kwenye mfuko wa pamoja wa mshikamano. Uhamishaji unaandikwa kwenye leja ya wazi kama mwingine wowote.

english: Your share is held for up to 14 days for the same patient's next confirmed bill. If none comes, it is refunded.
swahili: Sehemu yako inashikiliwa hadi siku 14 kwa ajili ya bili inayofuata iliyothibitishwa ya mgonjwa yule yule. Isipokuja, inarudishwa.

english: If a case is frozen because something looks wrong, every donor is refunded, whatever they chose.
swahili: Kesi ikisimamishwa kwa sababu kuna kitu kinaonekana si sawa, kila mchangiaji hurudishiwa pesa, bila kujali alichochagua.

english: This is a short summary written for the demo. The full notice will be published after legal review.
swahili: Hii ni muhtasari mfupi ulioandikwa kwa ajili ya onyesho. Notisi kamili itachapishwa baada ya ukaguzi wa kisheria.

english: What we collect, why, and how long we keep it.
swahili: Tunachokusanya, kwa nini, na tunakihifadhi kwa muda gani.

english: We collect as little as we can
Families give an email address, a patient reference and the bill. Donors give an email address for the receipt. We do not ask for anything else.
swahili: Familia hutoa barua pepe, rejea ya mgonjwa na bili. Wachangiaji hutoa barua pepe kwa ajili ya risiti. Hatuombi kitu kingine.

english: Diagnoses and similar details are removed from the bill text before it is stored or sent for analysis. Pages never show a diagnosis.
swahili: Utambuzi wa ugonjwa na maelezo kama hayo huondolewa kwenye maandishi ya bili kabla ya kuhifadhiwa au kutumwa kuchambuliwa. Kurasa kamwe hazionyeshi utambuzi.

english: Each use of the bill (hospital check, public page, analysis outside Kenya, receipts) has its own consent. You can withdraw a consent at any time from your dashboard.
swahili: Kila matumizi ya bili (ukaguzi wa hospitali, ukurasa wa umma, uchambuzi nje ya Kenya, risiti) lina ridhaa yake. Unaweza kuondoa ridhaa wakati wowote kutoka dashibodi yako.

english: Analysis outside Kenya needs your consent
swahili: Uchambuzi nje ya Kenya unahitaji ridhaa yako

english: Only the redacted text of a bill can leave our servers, and only if you agreed. Without that consent a local fallback is used.
swahili: Maandishi ya bili yaliyoondolewa maelezo pekee ndiyo yanaweza kutoka kwenye seva zetu, na ni ikiwa ulikubali tu. Bila ridhaa hiyo, mfumo wa ndani hutumika.

english: Bill files are deleted 24 hours after the hospital confirms them. Donor names appear on the public ledger only if the donor gave one and did not ask to be anonymous.
swahili: Faili za bili hufutwa saa 24 baada ya hospitali kuzithibitisha. Majina ya wachangiaji huonekana kwenye leja ya wazi tu ikiwa mchangiaji alitoa jina na hakuomba kutotambulika.

english: Software never rejects a case. A person reviews anything flagged, and a family can ask for a review at any time.
swahili: Programu kamwe haikatai kesi. Mtu hukagua chochote kilichoalamishwa, na familia inaweza kuomba ukaguzi wakati wowote.

english: The main rules for using TibaDirect.
We do not hold or keep donations
Donations are paid out to the confirmed hospital. TibaDirect does not pay families and does not keep donations for itself.
swahili: Michango hulipwa kwa hospitali iliyothibitishwa. TibaDirect hailipi familia na haihifadhi michango kwa manufaa yake.

english: The hospital is paid in tranches as money arrives. While a bill is an estimate, no more than 80% is paid until the final bill is confirmed.
swahili: Hospitali hulipwa kwa awamu pesa zinapofika. Bili ikiwa makadirio, si zaidi ya 80% hulipwa hadi bili ya mwisho ithibitishwe.

english: Leftover money follows the donor's choice
swahili: Pesa zinazobaki zinafuata chaguo la mchangiaji

english: If the final bill is lower or treatment ends early, leftover money is refunded, moved to the solidarity pool, or held briefly for follow-up care, as the donor chose.
swahili: Bili ya mwisho ikiwa ndogo au matibabu yakiisha mapema, pesa zinazobaki hurudishwa, kuhamishiwa mfuko wa mshikamano, au kushikiliwa kwa muda mfupi kwa matibabu ya kufuatilia, kama mchangiaji alivyochagua.

english: If a case looks fraudulent we can freeze it. Every donor is then refunded, whatever they chose.
swahili: Kesi ikionekana ya udanganyifu tunaweza kuisimamisha. Kila mchangiaji hurudishiwa pesa, bila kujali alichochagua.

english: Families must upload their own real bill and must not give false information. A false case is closed and reported.
swahili: Familia lazima zipakie bili yao halisi na zisitoe taarifa za uongo. Kesi ya uongo hufungwa na kuripotiwa.

english: This demo runs on sandbox money with made-up hospitals and bills. Nothing here is a real fundraiser.
swahili: Onyesho hili linatumia pesa za majaribio na hospitali na bili za kubuni. Hakuna kinachoonekana hapa ni mchango halisi.

english: Give in US dollars through PayPal. The hospital is paid, never the family.
swahili: Toa kwa dola za Marekani kupitia PayPal. Hospitali ndiyo inayolipwa, si familia.

english: About {{kes}} at today's rate. The exact amount is set when you pay.
swahili: Takriban {{kes}} kwa kiwango cha leo. Kiasi kamili kinawekwa unapolipa.

english: The Kenyan shilling amount appears once today's rate loads.
swahili: Kiasi cha shilingi kitaonekana kiwango cha leo kikipakiwa.

english: Name shown in the public ledger (optional)
swahili: Jina litakaloonekana kwenye leja ya wazi (si lazima)

english: You pay in PayPal's own window. We never see your card or password.
swahili: Unalipa kwenye dirisha la PayPal lenyewe. Hatuoni kadi wala nenosiri lako.

english: PayPal takes a small fee from each payment, so a little less than your gift reaches the case. Your receipt shows the exact amount.
swahili: PayPal huchukua ada ndogo kwa kila malipo, kwa hiyo kiasi kidogo kuliko mchango wako hufika kwenye kesi. Risiti yako inaonyesha kiasi kamili.

english: Thank you to everyone who gave. No more donations are needed for this bill.
swahili: Asante kwa wote waliotoa. Hakuna michango zaidi inayohitajika kwa bili hii.

english: The bill has been paid and this page is kept as a public record.
swahili: Bili imelipwa na ukurasa huu unahifadhiwa kama kumbukumbu ya wazi.

english: If there is money left over
Sometimes more money arrives than the bill needs. Choose what should happen to your share.
swahili: Wakati mwingine pesa nyingi kuliko bili zinahitaji hufika. Chagua kitakachotokea kwa sehemu yako.

english: Your leftover share goes back to you through PayPal. Under $1 goes to the solidarity pool.
swahili: Sehemu yako inayobaki inarudi kwako kupitia PayPal. Chini ya $1 huenda kwenye mfuko wa mshikamano.

english: Your leftover share goes into a shared pool, written in the public ledger.
swahili: Sehemu yako inayobaki inaenda kwenye mfuko wa pamoja, na inaandikwa kwenye leja ya wazi.

english: Held for up to 14 days for this patient's next confirmed bill, then refunded.
swahili: Inashikiliwa hadi siku 14 kwa bili inayofuata iliyothibitishwa ya mgonjwa huyu, kisha inarudishwa.

english: This case no longer needs more donations. You have not been charged.
swahili: Kesi hii haihitaji tena michango zaidi. Hujakatwa pesa.

english: This case is not taking donations right now.
swahili: Kesi hii haipokei michango kwa sasa.

english: PayPal is still checking this payment. We will email your receipt when it clears.
swahili: PayPal bado inakagua malipo haya. Tutakutumia risiti kwa barua pepe yakikamilika.

english: PayPal did not complete this payment. You have not been charged. Please try another way to pay.
swahili: PayPal haikukamilisha malipo haya. Hujakatwa pesa. Tafadhali jaribu njia nyingine ya kulipa.

english: PayPal could not be reached. You have not been charged. Please try again shortly.
swahili: PayPal haikufikiwa. Hujakatwa pesa. Tafadhali jaribu tena baadaye kidogo.

english: We could not complete your donation. You have not been charged. Please try again.
swahili: Hatukuweza kukamilisha mchango wako. Hujakatwa pesa. Tafadhali jaribu tena.

english: Your {{amount}} donation to {{alias}} is on its way to {{hospital}}.
The shilling amount uses the exchange rate at the time you paid. It is an estimate.
swahili: Kiasi cha shilingi kinatumia kiwango cha kubadilisha fedha wakati ulipolipa. Ni makadirio.

english: See it in the public ledger
Keep this link. It is your receipt and anyone with it can see it.
swahili: Hifadhi kiungo hiki. Ni risiti yako na yeyote mwenye kiungo anaweza kuiona.

english: This donation has been refunded in full.
{{amount}} of this donation has been refunded.
We could not find that receipt
Check the link in your email, or the one you saved.
swahili: Angalia kiungo kwenye barua pepe yako, au ulichohifadhi.

english: You can take back a consent at any time. Here is what each one changes.
swahili: Unaweza kuondoa ridhaa wakati wowote. Hiki ndicho kila moja inachobadilisha.

english: The hospital check is already done for this bill, so withdrawing it will not undo that.
swahili: Ukaguzi wa hospitali tayari umefanyika kwa bili hii, kwa hiyo kuuondoa hakutaurudisha nyuma.

english: The hospital has not confirmed your bill yet. If you withdraw this, your campaign ends.
swahili: Hospitali bado haijathibitisha bili yako. Ukiondoa hii, mchango wako unaisha.

english: Your page is hidden straight away and people can no longer give.
swahili: Ukurasa wako unafichwa mara moja na watu hawawezi tena kuchangia.

english: Automatic checks will use only the version that runs in Kenya from now on.
swahili: Kuanzia sasa ukaguzi wa kiotomatiki utatumia mfumo unaoendeshwa Kenya pekee.

english: We will stop sharing donation receipts with you.
swahili: Tutaacha kushiriki risiti za michango nawe.

english: Read each one. The first two are needed to send your campaign. The others are your choice.
swahili: Soma kila moja. Mbili za kwanza zinahitajika ili kutuma mchango wako. Nyingine ni chaguo lako.

english: I am this child's parent or legal guardian.
swahili: Mimi ni mzazi au mlezi wa kisheria wa mtoto huyu.

english: You can take this back later from your campaign page.
swahili: Unaweza kuiondoa baadaye kutoka ukurasa wa mchango wako.

english: Tick the two required consents to continue.
swahili: Weka alama kwenye ridhaa mbili zinazohitajika ili kuendelea.

english: The wording changed. Please read it again and confirm.
swahili: Maneno yamebadilika. Tafadhali yasome tena kisha uthibitishe.

english: For a child, a parent or legal guardian must give consent.
swahili: Kwa mtoto, mzazi au mlezi wa kisheria lazima atoe ridhaa.

english: Confirm the bill only if it is a real bill from your hospital. You can also ask the family a question or turn it down.
swahili: Thibitisha bili tu ikiwa ni bili halisi kutoka hospitali yako. Unaweza pia kuiuliza familia swali au kuikataa.

english: It is our bill. The family's page goes live for this amount.
swahili: Ni bili yetu. Ukurasa wa familia unaanza kutumika kwa kiasi hiki.

english: Something does not match. The family sees your note and can fix it.
swahili: Kuna kitu kisicholingana. Familia inaona ujumbe wako na inaweza kurekebisha.

english: We did not issue it. A person on our team will look at the case.
swahili: Hatukuitoa sisi. Mtu kwenye timu yetu ataangalia kesi.

english: Type the amount from your own records. It is not filled in for you.
swahili: Andika kiasi kutoka kwenye kumbukumbu zako. Hakijajazwa kwa niaba yako.

english: This matches the amount our software read.
swahili: Hii inalingana na kiasi kilichosomwa na programu yetu.

english: This is different from the {{total}} our software read. Check the original.
swahili: Hii ni tofauti na {{total}} iliyosomwa na programu yetu. Angalia asili.

english: If the family paid part of the bill already, enter that part so donors are not asked for it.
swahili: Familia ikiwa imelipa sehemu ya bili tayari, weka sehemu hiyo ili wachangiaji wasiombwe.

english: Treatment is complete and this is the last bill.
swahili: Matibabu yamekamilika na hii ndiyo bili ya mwisho.

english: This is a final bill for a case that is already live. The case closes once it has been paid.
swahili: Hii ni bili ya mwisho kwa kesi iliyo hai tayari. Kesi inafungwa ikishalipwa.

english: Bills of {{amount}} or more need a second approval. After you confirm, a different billing supervisor must approve with a new code before the page goes live.
swahili: Bili za {{amount}} au zaidi zinahitaji idhini ya pili. Baada ya kuthibitisha, msimamizi mwingine wa malipo lazima aidhinishe kwa msimbo mpya kabla ukurasa kuanza kutumika.

english: Why is this not your bill?
swahili: Kwa nini hii si bili yenu?

english: The family sees this. Do not include medical details.
swahili: Familia inaona hili. Usiweke maelezo ya kitabibu.

english: The bill is confirmed. The family's page is now live and the first payment will follow as money arrives.
swahili: Bili imethibitishwa. Ukurasa wa familia sasa uko hai na malipo ya kwanza yatafuata pesa zinapofika.

english: Your question has gone to the family. They can correct the bill and send it again.
swahili: Swali lako limeenda kwa familia. Wanaweza kurekebisha bili na kuituma tena.

english: The bill was not confirmed. A person on our team will look at the case.
swahili: Bili haikuthibitishwa. Mtu kwenye timu yetu ataangalia kesi.

english: Confirmed. This amount needs a second approval from a different billing supervisor before the page goes live.
swahili: Imethibitishwa. Kiasi hiki kinahitaji idhini ya pili kutoka kwa msimamizi mwingine wa malipo kabla ukurasa kuanza kutumika.

english: This bill is no longer waiting for a decision. The page has been refreshed.
swahili: Bili hii haisubiri tena uamuzi. Ukurasa umesasishwa.

english: Enter the total from the bill.
That amount is too large. Check it.
swahili: Kiasi hicho ni kikubwa mno. Kiangalie.

english: Enter the invoice number from the bill.
swahili: Weka namba ya ankara kutoka kwenye bili.

english: That invoice number is already used on another case at this hospital.
swahili: Namba hiyo ya ankara tayari imetumika kwenye kesi nyingine katika hospitali hii.

english: The deposit cannot be more than the bill.
swahili: Amana haiwezi kuwa kubwa kuliko bili.

english: Write at least a few words for the family.
swahili: Andika angalau maneno machache kwa familia.

english: Got a message asking for money for a hospital bill? Paste it here, or upload a screenshot, and we will tell you what looks risky.
swahili: Umepata ujumbe unaoomba pesa kwa bili ya hospitali? Bandika hapa, au pakia picha ya skrini, nasi tutakuambia kinachoonekana hatari.

english: We do not keep what you paste or upload. Only a fingerprint of it is kept, to count how many times the same message goes around.
swahili: Hatuhifadhi unachobandika au kupakia. Alama ya kidijitali yake tu ndiyo huhifadhiwa, ili kuhesabu mara ambazo ujumbe ule ule unasambaa.

english: How to give us the message
The message, exactly as you received it
We read the words from the picture. If we cannot read enough, paste the message instead.
swahili: Tunasoma maneno kutoka kwenye picha. Tusipoweza kusoma ya kutosha, bandika ujumbe badala yake.

english: This is a guide, not proof. A message that looks fine can still be a scam, and a confirmed case is the only way to be sure the money reaches the hospital.
swahili: Huu ni mwongozo, si ushahidi. Ujumbe unaoonekana sawa bado unaweza kuwa utapeli, na kesi iliyothibitishwa ndiyo njia pekee ya kuwa na uhakika pesa zinafika hospitalini.

english: The appeal checker is switched off
It is not available in this environment.
We did not find the usual signs of a scam. Still, only give through a page where the hospital has confirmed the bill.
swahili: Hatukuona dalili za kawaida za utapeli. Hata hivyo, changia tu kupitia ukurasa ambapo hospitali imethibitisha bili.

english: Some things about this message are often seen in scams. Check it with the hospital before you give.
swahili: Baadhi ya mambo kuhusu ujumbe huu huonekana mara nyingi kwenye utapeli. Uliza hospitali kabla ya kutoa.

english: It has several of the signs that fake appeals use. Do not send money, and do not share it.
swahili: Una dalili kadhaa zinazotumiwa na maombi ya uongo. Usitume pesa, na usiusambaze.

english: The appeal looks like {{alias}}'s case at {{hospital}}, which the hospital has confirmed.
swahili: Ombi hili linafanana na kesi ya {{alias}} katika {{hospital}}, ambayo hospitali imethibitisha.

english: The appeal checker is not available right now.
We could not read enough text in that picture. Paste the message instead.
swahili: Hatukuweza kusoma maandishi ya kutosha kwenye picha hiyo. Bandika ujumbe badala yake.

english: Please paste a message of at least 20 characters.
swahili: Tafadhali bandika ujumbe wa angalau herufi 20.

english: Verified medical fundraising that pays the hospital, not a stranger's phone number.
swahili: Uchangishaji wa matibabu uliothibitishwa, unaolipa hospitali moja kwa moja.

english: The service is not reachable right now.

swahili: Iko kwa timu yetu ya ukaguzi

english: The amount will show here once the hospital confirms the bill.
swahili: Kiasi kitaonekana hapa hospitali itakapothibitisha bili.

english: {{pledged}} pledged and {{settled}} paid to the hospital, out of {{target}}.
swahili: {{pledged}} zimeahidiwa na {{settled}} zimelipwa hospitalini, kati ya {{target}}.

english: {{pledged}} pledged and {{settled}} paid to the hospital. The bill amount is not confirmed yet.
swahili: {{pledged}} zimeahidiwa na {{settled}} zimelipwa hospitalini. Kiasi cha bili bado hakijathibitishwa.

english: You are giving this on behalf of the patient.
swahili: Unatoa ridhaa hii kwa niaba ya mgonjwa.

english: Drop the bill here, or choose a file
swahili: Weka bili hapa, au chagua faili

english: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB.
swahili: PDF, PNG au JPEG, hadi MB 10.

english: Please choose a PDF, PNG or JPEG file.
swahili: Tafadhali chagua faili ya PDF, PNG au JPEG.

english: This file is larger than 10 MB.
swahili: Faili hii ni kubwa kuliko MB 10.

english: Please choose a PNG or JPEG picture.
swahili: Tafadhali chagua picha ya PNG au JPEG.

english: Drop the screenshot here, or choose a picture
swahili: Weka picha ya skrini hapa, au chagua picha

english: PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB.
Demo: this uses PayPal sandbox money. No real money moves and no real patients are shown.
swahili: Onyesho: hii inatumia pesa za majaribio za PayPal. Hakuna pesa halisi zinazohamishwa wala wagonjwa halisi wanaoonyeshwa.

english: Enter your email and we will send you a 6-digit code.
swahili: Weka barua pepe yako nasi tutakutumia msimbo wa tarakimu 6.
Weka anwani yako ya barua pepe.
Weka anwani sahihi ya barua pepe.

english: There is no password to remember. If you are new, signing in creates your family account.
swahili: Hakuna nenosiri la kukumbuka. Ikiwa wewe ni mgeni, kuingia kunafungua akaunti yako ya familia.

english: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It works once and lasts 10 minutes.
swahili: Tumetuma msimbo wa tarakimu 6 kwa {{email}}. Unatumika mara moja na unadumu dakika 10.

english: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check your email and try again, or ask for a new code.
swahili: Msimbo huo si sahihi, au muda wake umeisha. Angalia barua pepe yako kisha ujaribu tena, au omba msimbo mpya.
Tuma msimbo mpya baada ya sekunde {{seconds}}

english: These are made-up accounts for the demo:
swahili: Hizi ni akaunti za kubuni za onyesho:

english: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
Every case here has a bill that the hospital itself has confirmed, or is waiting for the hospital to confirm. Pick one to see the details.
swahili: Kila kesi hapa ina bili ambayo hospitali yenyewe imethibitisha, au inasubiri hospitali kuithibitisha. Chagua moja uone maelezo.

english: New cases appear here once a hospital has confirmed the bill. Please check again soon.
swahili: Kesi mpya huonekana hapa hospitali ikishathibitisha bili. Tafadhali angalia tena baadaye.

english: Try another county, or look at all counties.
swahili: Jaribu kaunti nyingine, au tazama kaunti zote.

english: Pay the hospital, not a stranger's phone number.
swahili: Lipa hospitali, si simu ya mtu usiyemjua.

english: Families share a hospital bill that the hospital itself confirms. Donors anywhere in the world give in US dollars through PayPal, and the money goes to the hospital in parts as it is needed.
swahili: Familia zinashiriki bili ya hospitali ambayo hospitali yenyewe inathibitisha. Wachangiaji popote duniani wanatoa kwa dola za Marekani kupitia PayPal, na pesa hulipwa hospitalini kwa awamu kadiri zinavyohitajika.

english: We verify the bill, not the illness.
The money never touches a middleman
swahili: Pesa hazipiti kwa mtu wa kati

english: Donations are paid out to the hospital, never to the family or to us. Every movement of money is written in a public ledger anyone can check.
swahili: Michango hulipwa hospitalini, kamwe si kwa familia wala kwetu. Kila uhamishaji wa pesa unaandikwa kwenye leja ya wazi ambayo yeyote anaweza kuikagua.

english: How your money reaches the hospital
Four steps, from the family's bill to the hospital's account.
swahili: Hatua nne, kutoka bili ya familia hadi akaunti ya hospitali.

english: They upload the hospital bill. Medical details are removed before anything is checked.
swahili: Wanapakia bili ya hospitali. Maelezo ya kitabibu huondolewa kabla ya ukaguzi wowote.

english: The hospital's billing office confirms the amount with a code sent to its official email.
swahili: Ofisi ya malipo ya hospitali inathibitisha kiasi kwa msimbo unaotumwa kwa barua pepe yake rasmi.

english: Choose an amount in US dollars. You also choose what happens to anything left over.
swahili: Chagua kiasi kwa dola za Marekani. Pia unachagua kitakachotokea kwa pesa zitakazobaki.

english: Money is paid to the hospital in parts as it arrives. It is never paid to the family.
swahili: Pesa hulipwa hospitalini kwa awamu kadiri zinavyofika. Kamwe hazilipwi kwa familia.

english: Got a fundraising message on WhatsApp?
swahili: Umepata ujumbe wa kuchangisha kwenye WhatsApp?

english: Paste it or upload a screenshot and we will tell you what looks risky, and whether it matches a confirmed case. We do not keep what you paste.
swahili: Bandika ujumbe au pakia picha ya skrini nasi tutakuambia kinachoonekana hatari, na kama unalingana na kesi iliyothibitishwa. Hatuhifadhi unachobandika.

english: These are demo figures from made-up cases and sandbox money.
swahili: Hizi ni takwimu za onyesho kutoka kesi za kubuni na pesa za majaribio.

english: Two things have to be true before you give: the bill is real, and the money reaches the hospital. We handle them separately, so you can check each one.
swahili: Mambo mawili lazima yawe kweli kabla ya kutoa: bili ni halisi, na pesa zinafika hospitalini. Tunayashughulikia kando, ili uweze kukagua kila moja.

english: The two parts of every case
We verify the bill, not the illness. The donor's money touches the hospital, never a middleman.
swahili: Tunathibitisha bili, si ugonjwa. Pesa ya mchangiaji hufika hospitalini, kamwe si kwa mtu wa kati.

english: The trust part. It happens before any money is accepted.
swahili: Sehemu ya uaminifu. Hufanyika kabla pesa yoyote kukubaliwa.

english: A family member signs in, chooses the hospital, agrees to what we may do with the bill, and uploads it. Medical details are removed before anything is stored or analysed.
swahili: Mwanafamilia anaingia, anachagua hospitali, anakubali tunachoweza kufanya na bili, na kuipakia. Maelezo ya kitabibu huondolewa kabla ya kuhifadhi au kuchambua chochote.

english: A helper reads and checks it
Software reads the amount and looks for edits, copies and scam patterns. It only explains what it finds. It never turns a family away: a person reviews anything that looks risky.
swahili: Programu inasoma kiasi na kutafuta mabadiliko, nakala na mbinu za utapeli. Inaeleza tu inachokipata. Kamwe haikatai familia: mtu hukagua chochote kinachoonekana hatari.

english: The hospital's billing office gets a one-time code at the official email address in the facility register, never an address printed on the bill. Large bills need two people to agree.
swahili: Ofisi ya malipo ya hospitali hupokea msimbo wa mara moja kwenye barua pepe rasmi iliyo kwenye daftari la vituo vya afya, kamwe si anwani iliyochapishwa kwenye bili. Bili kubwa zinahitaji watu wawili kukubali.

english: The case page shows a hospital-confirmed badge, the amount and the family's story. It never shows a diagnosis.
swahili: Ukurasa wa kesi unaonyesha alama ya kuthibitishwa na hospitali, kiasi na hadithi ya familia. Kamwe haonyeshi utambuzi wa ugonjwa.

english: Does the money reach the hospital?
The money part. It follows the hospital's confirmed bill.
swahili: Sehemu ya pesa. Inafuata bili iliyothibitishwa na hospitali.

english: Pay with PayPal. The page shows the bill in Kenyan shillings, with a small buffer for exchange-rate changes and fees.
swahili: Lipa kwa PayPal. Ukurasa unaonyesha bili kwa shilingi za Kenya, pamoja na ziada ndogo kwa mabadiliko ya viwango vya kubadilisha fedha na ada.

english: It is written in a public ledger
Every movement is recorded in a chain of fingerprints that anyone can check. TibaDirect does not keep donations for itself.
swahili: Kila uhamishaji unarekodiwa kwenye mnyororo wa alama za kidijitali ambazo yeyote anaweza kuzikagua. TibaDirect haihifadhi michango kwa manufaa yake.

english: The hospital is paid in parts
As money arrives, the hospital is paid in tranches. While the bill is only an estimate, no more than 80% is paid until the final bill is confirmed.
swahili: Pesa zinapofika, hospitali hulipwa kwa awamu. Bili ikiwa makadirio tu, si zaidi ya 80% hulipwa hadi bili ya mwisho ithibitishwe.

english: The final bill closes the case
When the final bill has been paid, the case closes and the page says so.
swahili: Bili ya mwisho ikishalipwa, kesi inafungwa na ukurasa unasema hivyo.

english: Anything left over follows your choice
If there is money left, it goes where each donor chose when they gave. See below.
swahili: Ikiwa pesa zimebaki, zinaenda kule kila mchangiaji alikochagua alipotoa. Tazama hapa chini.

english: What is real and what is simulated
swahili: Kipi ni halisi na kipi ni cha kuigiza

english: The bill checks, the hospital confirmation steps and the review by a person.
swahili: Ukaguzi wa bili, hatua za uthibitisho wa hospitali na ukaguzi wa mtu.

english: The public ledger and its fingerprints, which you can verify on every case.
swahili: Leja ya wazi na alama zake za kidijitali, unazoweza kuzithibitisha kwenye kila kesi.

english: The rules for tranches, refunds and leftover money.
swahili: Kanuni za awamu za malipo, marejesho na pesa zinazobaki.

english: Sign-in by emailed code and the privacy rules for what is stored.
swahili: Kuingia kwa msimbo wa barua pepe na kanuni za faragha kuhusu kinachohifadhiwa.

english: The money: payments run on PayPal's sandbox, so no real money moves.
swahili: Pesa: malipo yanaendeshwa kwenye mazingira ya majaribio ya PayPal, kwa hiyo hakuna pesa halisi zinazohamishwa.

english: Payments to the hospital go to a sandbox account. In production a licensed Kenyan settlement partner would pay the hospital's paybill or bank account.
swahili: Malipo kwa hospitali yanaenda kwenye akaunti ya majaribio. Kwa matumizi halisi, mshirika wa malipo mwenye leseni nchini Kenya angelipa paybill au akaunti ya benki ya hospitali.

english: The hospitals, families and bills are made up, and no real patient is shown.
swahili: Hospitali, familia na bili ni za kubuni, na hakuna mgonjwa halisi anayeonyeshwa.

english: Emails go to a test inbox, not to real addresses.
swahili: Barua pepe zinaenda kwenye kisanduku cha majaribio, si kwa anwani halisi.

english: No. Payments go through PayPal and are paid out to the hospital in parts. We do not spend or keep donations, and the public ledger shows where each one went.
swahili: Hapana. Malipo yanapita PayPal na kulipwa hospitalini kwa awamu. Hatutumii wala kuhifadhi michango, na leja ya wazi inaonyesha kila mchango ulikoenda.

english: Who can see the patient's details?
swahili: Nani anaweza kuona maelezo ya mgonjwa?

english: Donors see an alias, a region, the hospital and the amounts. The patient reference is only visible to the family and the hospital, and bill files are deleted 24 hours after the hospital confirms.
swahili: Wachangiaji wanaona jina la utambulisho, eneo, hospitali na kiasi. Rejea ya mgonjwa inaonekana kwa familia na hospitali pekee, na faili za bili hufutwa saa 24 baada ya hospitali kuthibitisha.

english: What if the final bill is lower than the estimate?
swahili: Je, bili ya mwisho ikiwa ndogo kuliko makadirio?

english: The hospital is paid only the confirmed amount. Anything left over follows each donor's choice.
swahili: Hospitali inalipwa kiasi kilichothibitishwa tu. Kinachobaki kinafuata chaguo la kila mchangiaji.

english: What if a case turns out to be fake?
swahili: Je, kesi ikionekana ni ya uongo?

english: An administrator can freeze a case at any time. Every donor is then refunded.
swahili: Msimamizi anaweza kusimamisha kesi wakati wowote. Kila mchangiaji hurudishiwa pesa.

english: Do I need an account to give?
No. You only need PayPal. You can give anonymously or with a name of your choice.
swahili: Hapana. Unahitaji PayPal tu. Unaweza kutoa bila kujitambulisha au kwa jina utakalochagua.

english: Every movement of money for this case, oldest first. Each entry carries a fingerprint that depends on the one before it, so an entry cannot be changed or removed without breaking the chain.
swahili: Kila uhamishaji wa pesa wa kesi hii, wa zamani kwanza. Kila rekodi ina alama ya kidijitali inayotegemea ile iliyotangulia, kwa hiyo rekodi haiwezi kubadilishwa au kuondolewa bila kuvunja mnyororo.

english: Recomputes every fingerprint for this case on our server.
swahili: Inakokotoa upya kila alama ya kidijitali ya kesi hii kwenye seva yetu.

english: We rechecked all {{count}} entries for this case and every fingerprint matches. The newest one starts with {{hash}}.
swahili: Tumekagua tena rekodi zote {{count}} za kesi hii na kila alama ya kidijitali inalingana. Ya hivi karibuni inaanza na {{hash}}.

english: Something in the chain does not match. Please tell us so we can look into it, and be careful about giving until we have.
swahili: Kuna kitu kwenye mnyororo kisicholingana. Tafadhali tuambie ili tuchunguze, na uwe mwangalifu kuhusu kutoa hadi tutakapomaliza.

english: Nothing has been paid to the hospital yet. A payment is made once enough has been pledged.
swahili: Hakuna kilicholipwa hospitalini bado. Malipo hufanywa pesa za kutosha zikishaahidiwa.

english: Payments to the hospital are simulated here: they go to the hospital's sandbox PayPal account. In production a licensed Kenyan partner pays the hospital's paybill or bank account.
swahili: Malipo kwa hospitali yanaigizwa hapa: yanaenda kwenye akaunti ya majaribio ya PayPal ya hospitali. Kwa matumizi halisi, mshirika mwenye leseni nchini Kenya angelipa paybill au akaunti ya benki ya hospitali.

english: The family has not added a story yet.
We verify the bill, not the illness. No diagnosis is shown on any case.
swahili: Tunathibitisha bili, si ugonjwa. Hakuna utambuzi wa ugonjwa unaoonyeshwa kwenye kesi yoyote.

english: This is an estimate. Until the final bill is confirmed, no more than 80% of it is paid to the hospital.
swahili: Hili ni makadirio. Hadi bili ya mwisho ithibitishwe, si zaidi ya 80% hulipwa hospitalini.

english: This case is closed. The page stays as a public record.
swahili: Kesi hii imefungwa. Ukurasa unabaki kama kumbukumbu ya wazi.

english: We could not find that case
It may be private, paused for a check, or the link may be wrong.
swahili: Huenda ni ya faragha, imesimamishwa kwa ukaguzi, au kiungo si sahihi.

english: Please help with {{alias}}'s hospital bill on TibaDirect:
swahili: Tafadhali saidia bili ya hospitali ya {{alias}} kwenye TibaDirect:

english: You have not started a campaign yet
It takes about five minutes. You will need the hospital bill and the patient or admission number from it.
swahili: Inachukua takriban dakika tano. Utahitaji bili ya hospitali na namba ya mgonjwa au ya kulazwa iliyo kwenye bili.

english: Finish your campaign and send it for checking
swahili: Maliza mchango wako na uutume ukaguliwe

english: We are checking your bill. This usually takes a minute.
swahili: Tunakagua bili yako. Kwa kawaida huchukua dakika moja.

english: A person on our team is looking at your case.
swahili: Mtu kwenye timu yetu anaangalia kesi yako.

english: Waiting for the hospital to confirm your bill.
Live. Share your page so people can give.
swahili: Hai. Shiriki ukurasa wako ili watu wachangie.

english: Live. Money has been pledged and is being paid to the hospital.
swahili: Hai. Pesa zimeahidiwa na zinalipwa hospitalini.

english: Fully funded. The hospital is being paid.
Closed. Thank you for sharing your story.
swahili: Imefungwa. Asante kwa kushiriki hadithi yako.

english: Paused while we check something. Donors are being refunded.
swahili: Imesimamishwa tunapokagua kitu. Wachangiaji wanarudishiwa pesa.

english: Your page is paused while we check something. Donors who gave are being refunded. If you think this is a mistake, ask for a review below.
swahili: Ukurasa wako umesimamishwa tunapokagua kitu. Wachangiaji waliotoa wanarudishiwa pesa. Ukiona ni kosa, omba ukaguzi hapa chini.
Zilizopokelewa baada ya ada za PayPal

english: Money is paid to the hospital, never to you. You will see it move here as it is paid.
swahili: Pesa hulipwa hospitalini, kamwe si kwako. Utaziona zikisogea hapa zinapolipwa.

english: These are things our checks noticed, not a verdict. A person always decides, and you can ask for a review.
swahili: Haya ni mambo ambayo ukaguzi wetu uliona, si hukumu. Mtu daima ndiye anayeamua, na unaweza kuomba ukaguzi.

english: Sent to the hospital's billing office to confirm.
swahili: Imetumwa kwa ofisi ya malipo ya hospitali ili kuthibitisha.

english: A person on our team is reviewing it.
The checks have not finished yet.
The checks run after you send your campaign.
swahili: Ukaguzi huendeshwa baada ya kutuma mchango wako.

english: Ask a person to look at your case
Tell us what you would like us to look at. Do not include medical details.
swahili: Tuambie unachotaka tuangalie. Usiweke maelezo ya kitabibu.

english: You already asked for a review. We will look at it soon.
swahili: Tayari uliomba ukaguzi. Tutaliangalia hivi karibuni.

english: A review can be asked for after a case is sent, and until it ends.
swahili: Ukaguzi unaweza kuombwa baada ya kesi kutumwa, na hadi inapoisha.
Tafadhali andika herufi kati ya 10 na 500.

english: Waiting for a second person at the hospital
When treatment ends, upload the hospital's final bill. The hospital confirms it, we pay what is still due, and the case closes.
swahili: Matibabu yakiisha, pakia bili ya mwisho ya hospitali. Hospitali inaithibitisha, tunalipa kinachobaki, na kesi inafungwa.

english: Your final bill is being checked and sent to the hospital.
swahili: Bili yako ya mwisho inakaguliwa na kutumwa hospitalini.

english: If treatment has been cancelled or is no longer needed, you can end the campaign. Donations stop straight away.
swahili: Ikiwa matibabu yameghairiwa au hayahitajiki tena, unaweza kumaliza mchango. Michango inasimama mara moja.

english: Donations stop at once. Money the case no longer needs goes back to donors or on, as each donor chose. This cannot be undone.
swahili: Michango inasimama mara moja. Pesa ambazo kesi haizihitaji tena zinarudishwa kwa wachangiaji au kuendelea, kama kila mchangiaji alivyochagua. Hili haliwezi kutenduliwa.

english: This campaign cannot be ended from where it is.
swahili: Mchango huu hauwezi kumalizwa ulipo sasa.

english: This draft was never sent. Deleting it removes it for good.
swahili: Rasimu hii haikutumwa kamwe. Kuifuta kunaiondoa moja kwa moja.

english: The draft and its uploaded bills will be removed.
We could not find that campaign
It may belong to another account, or the link may be wrong.
swahili: Huenda ni wa akaunti nyingine, au kiungo si sahihi.

english: Five short steps. Your progress is saved, so you can stop and come back.
swahili: Hatua tano fupi. Maendeleo yako yanahifadhiwa, kwa hiyo unaweza kusimama na kurudi.

english: Choose the hospital. We will ask its billing office to confirm the bill.
swahili: Chagua hospitali. Tutaomba ofisi yake ya malipo ithibitishe bili.

english: No hospital matches that. Try a different name or county.
swahili: Hakuna hospitali inayolingana. Jaribu jina au kaunti nyingine.

english: The hospital cannot be changed once the draft is started. To pick another, delete this draft and start again.
swahili: Hospitali haiwezi kubadilishwa rasimu ikishaanzishwa. Ili kuchagua nyingine, futa rasimu hii kisha uanze upya.

english: Use a first name or nickname, not the patient's full name, and no illness words.
swahili: Tumia jina la kwanza au jina la utani, si jina kamili la mgonjwa, na bila maneno ya ugonjwa.

english: On the page it will read: {{alias}} · {{region}}
Patient or admission number from the bill
swahili: Namba ya mgonjwa au ya kulazwa kutoka kwenye bili

english: Only you and the hospital can see this. It is never shown on the public page.
swahili: Wewe na hospitali pekee mnaweza kuiona. Haionyeshwi kamwe kwenye ukurasa wa umma.

english: A parent or legal guardian must give consent for a child.
swahili: Mzazi au mlezi wa kisheria lazima atoe ridhaa kwa mtoto.

english: Choose a hospital from the list.
Do not put an email address or phone number in the name.
swahili: Usiweke barua pepe au namba ya simu kwenye jina.

english: Please leave out illness words from the name.
swahili: Tafadhali acha maneno ya ugonjwa kwenye jina.

english: Enter a county or town, 2 to 40 letters.
swahili: Weka kaunti au mji, herufi 2 hadi 40.

english: Enter the admission or patient number from the bill (3 to 60 characters).
swahili: Weka namba ya kulazwa au ya mgonjwa kutoka kwenye bili (herufi 3 hadi 60).

english: Do not put an email address, phone number or long number in the story.
swahili: Usiweke barua pepe, namba ya simu au namba ndefu kwenye hadithi.

english: Please leave out medical words. The hospital bill already shows the care given.
swahili: Tafadhali acha maneno ya kitabibu. Bili ya hospitali tayari inaonyesha huduma iliyotolewa.

english: We could not save your story. Please try again.
swahili: Hatukuweza kuhifadhi hadithi yako. Tafadhali jaribu tena.

english: A photo or PDF of the bill. We read the amount and remove medical details before anything is stored for checking.
swahili: Picha au PDF ya bili. Tunasoma kiasi na kuondoa maelezo ya kitabibu kabla ya kuhifadhi chochote kwa ukaguzi.

english: For this demo, use a made-up bill only. Never upload a real patient's bill.
swahili: Kwa onyesho hili, tumia bili ya kubuni tu. Usipakie kamwe bili ya mgonjwa halisi.

english: What kind of bill is it?
swahili: Hii ni bili ya aina gani?

english: The hospital is asking for payment for care already given.
swahili: Hospitali inaomba malipo ya huduma iliyokwisha tolewa.

english: A quote for care that is planned but not given yet.
swahili: Bei ya huduma iliyopangwa lakini haijatolewa bado.

english: We could not upload that file. Please try again.
swahili: Hatukuweza kupakia faili hiyo. Tafadhali jaribu tena.

english: Upload at least one bill to continue.
swahili: Pakia angalau bili moja ili kuendelea.

english: This is what donors will read. Write about your family, not the illness.
swahili: Hiki ndicho wachangiaji watakachosoma. Andika kuhusu familia yako, si ugonjwa.

english: No diagnosis, phone numbers or emails.
swahili: Bila utambuzi wa ugonjwa, namba za simu au barua pepe.
Imehifadhiwa. Hakuna maneno ya kitabibu yaliyopatikana.

english: Photos are switched off in this demo.
How your page will look in the list
swahili: Jinsi ukurasa wako utakavyoonekana kwenye orodha

english: The bill amount and the hospital badge appear after the hospital confirms.
swahili: Kiasi cha bili na alama ya hospitali huonekana baada ya hospitali kuthibitisha.

english: Look this over. When you send it, we check the bill and then ask the hospital to confirm it.
swahili: Pitia haya. Ukiituma, tunakagua bili kisha tunaomba hospitali iithibitishe.

english: After you send: we check the bill (usually a minute), then the hospital's billing office confirms it with a code sent to its official email. You can follow each step on your campaign page.
swahili: Baada ya kutuma: tunakagua bili (kwa kawaida dakika moja), kisha ofisi ya malipo ya hospitali inaithibitisha kwa msimbo unaotumwa kwa barua pepe yake rasmi. Unaweza kufuatilia kila hatua kwenye ukurasa wa mchango wako.

english: Both required consents and at least one bill are needed before you can send.
swahili: Ridhaa mbili zinazohitajika na angalau bili moja vinahitajika kabla ya kutuma.

english: Sent. We are checking your bill.
Bills families have sent to {{hospital}} to confirm. Open one to compare it with the original and decide.
swahili: Bili ambazo familia zimetuma kwa {{hospital}} ili kuthibitisha. Fungua moja uilinganishe na asili kisha uamue.

english: New bills appear here as soon as a family sends one.
swahili: Bili mpya huonekana hapa familia inapotuma.

english: Large bills need a second person. A different billing supervisor approves them with a new code.
swahili: Bili kubwa zinahitaji mtu wa pili. Msimamizi mwingine wa malipo huziidhinisha kwa msimbo mpya.

english: No bills are waiting for a second approval.
swahili: Hakuna bili zinazosubiri idhini ya pili.

english: We could not find that bill
It may belong to another hospital, or the link may be wrong.
swahili: Huenda ni ya hospitali nyingine, au kiungo si sahihi.
Namba ya mgonjwa au ya kulazwa

english: You see only the alias and the patient number on the bill, so you can match it to your records. The family's contact details are never shown.
swahili: Unaona jina la utambulisho na namba ya mgonjwa kwenye bili pekee, ili uilinganishe na kumbukumbu zako. Mawasiliano ya familia hayaonyeshwi kamwe.

english: This bill is not waiting for a decision.
No bill was uploaded for this case.
swahili: Hakuna bili iliyopakiwa kwa kesi hii.

english: The original file has been deleted. Files are removed 24 hours after the hospital confirms a bill.
swahili: Faili ya asili imefutwa. Faili huondolewa saa 24 baada ya hospitali kuthibitisha bili.

english: Check the amount, the invoice number and the patient number against your own records.
swahili: Linganisha kiasi, namba ya ankara na namba ya mgonjwa na kumbukumbu zako mwenyewe.

english: Use this to compare with the original. It can be wrong, so decide from your own records.
swahili: Tumia hii kulinganisha na asili. Inaweza kukosea, kwa hiyo amua kwa kumbukumbu zako mwenyewe.

english: The bill has not been checked yet.

swahili: Msomaji alikuwa na uhakika kiasi gani

english: To protect the hospital, a code is sent only to the address in the facility register: {{address}}. Someone there reads it to you.
swahili: Ili kulinda hospitali, msimbo hutumwa tu kwenye anwani iliyo kwenye daftari la vituo vya afya: {{address}}. Mtu aliye huko atakusomea.

english: A code was sent to {{address}}. It works until {{time}}.
swahili: Msimbo umetumwa kwa {{address}}. Unafanya kazi hadi {{time}}.
Msimbo wa tarakimu 6 kutoka anwani hiyo
Tuma msimbo mpya baada ya sekunde {{seconds}}

english: Too many codes were sent for this bill. Please try again in an hour.
swahili: Misimbo mingi sana imetumwa kwa bili hii. Tafadhali jaribu tena baada ya saa moja.

english: The code could not be emailed. Please try again shortly.
swahili: Msimbo haukuweza kutumwa kwa barua pepe. Tafadhali jaribu tena baadaye kidogo.

english: This bill is not waiting for that step.
Send a code and enter it before you submit.
swahili: Tuma msimbo na uuweke kabla ya kuwasilisha.

english: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
That code is not right. Check it and try again.
swahili: Msimbo huo si sahihi. Uangalie kisha ujaribu tena.

english: That code has expired. Send a new one.
swahili: Muda wa msimbo huo umeisha. Tuma mpya.

english: Too many wrong tries. Send a new code.
swahili: Umekosea mara nyingi. Tuma msimbo mpya.

english: {{name}} confirmed {{amount}} (invoice {{invoice}}). Because it is a large bill, a different billing supervisor must approve it.
swahili: {{name}} amethibitisha {{amount}} (ankara {{invoice}}). Kwa kuwa ni bili kubwa, msimamizi mwingine wa malipo lazima aiidhinishe.

english: Both approvals are in. The family's page is now live.
swahili: Idhini zote mbili zimepatikana. Ukurasa wa familia sasa uko hai.

english: A different billing supervisor must give the second approval. You confirmed this bill.
swahili: Msimamizi mwingine wa malipo lazima atoe idhini ya pili. Wewe ndiye uliyethibitisha bili hii.

english: Only a billing supervisor can give the second approval.
swahili: Msimamizi wa malipo pekee ndiye anayeweza kutoa idhini ya pili.

english: Each payment TibaDirect has made to your hospital, newest first.
swahili: Kila malipo ambayo TibaDirect imefanya kwa hospitali yako, ya hivi karibuni kwanza.

english: Payments appear here once a confirmed case has enough money pledged.
swahili: Malipo yanaonekana hapa kesi iliyothibitishwa ikishapata pesa za kutosha zilizoahidiwa.

english: Flagged by the checks or asked for by a family
swahili: Zimealamishwa na ukaguzi au familia imeomba

english: The job queues cannot be reached.
Recomputes every fingerprint in the whole ledger, across all cases, and says where it breaks if it does.
swahili: Inakokotoa upya kila alama ya kidijitali kwenye leja nzima, kwa kesi zote, na inasema inapovunjika.

english: All {{count}} entries were rechecked and every fingerprint matches.
swahili: Rekodi zote {{count}} zimekaguliwa tena na kila alama ya kidijitali inalingana.

english: The chain fails at entry {{seq}}. Stop paying out and find out why.
swahili: Mnyororo unashindwa kwenye rekodi {{seq}}. Acha kulipa kisha ujue sababu.

english: Search by alias, link name, hospital or owner email
swahili: Tafuta kwa jina, jina la kiungo, hospitali au barua pepe ya mmiliki

english: Open a case to see everything about it. Opening a case is written to the audit log.
swahili: Fungua kesi uone kila kitu kuhusu hiyo. Kufungua kesi kunaandikwa kwenye kumbukumbu za ukaguzi.

english: Cases the checks flagged, or that a family asked us to look at. Nothing is rejected automatically: a person decides, and must say why.
swahili: Kesi ambazo ukaguzi uliziwekea alama, au familia iliomba tuziangalie. Hakuna kinachokataliwa kiotomatiki: mtu anaamua, na lazima aseme kwa nini.

english: Use the button on a row, or click the row, to open it.
swahili: Tumia kitufe kwenye safu, au bonyeza safu, ili kuifungua.

english: This item was already resolved, or the case cannot take that decision.
swahili: Kipengee hiki tayari kimeshughulikiwa, au kesi haiwezi kupokea uamuzi huo.

english: Satisfied. The bill goes to the hospital's billing office to confirm.
swahili: Nimeridhika. Bili inaenda kwa ofisi ya malipo ya hospitali kuthibitisha.

english: The case stays unverified until something changes.
swahili: Kesi inabaki bila uthibitisho hadi kitu kibadilike.

english: The campaign ends and donors are refunded as they chose.
swahili: Mchango unaisha na wachangiaji wanarudishiwa kama walivyochagua.

english: Close the item without changing the case.
Every sign-in, decision and movement of money, newest first. Entries cannot be changed.
swahili: Kila kuingia, uamuzi na uhamishaji wa pesa, wa hivi karibuni kwanza. Rekodi haziwezi kubadilishwa.

english: That is not a full ID.
Open a row to see the details of that entry.
swahili: Fungua safu uone maelezo ya rekodi hiyo.

english: Bill checks, payments and emails run in the background. A failed job can be put back on its queue.
swahili: Ukaguzi wa bili, malipo na barua pepe hufanyika nyuma. Kazi iliyoshindwa inaweza kurudishwa kwenye foleni yake.

english: The job is back on its queue.
That job has not failed, so it cannot be retried.
swahili: Kazi hiyo haijashindwa, kwa hiyo haiwezi kujaribiwa tena.

english: We could not find that case
Opening this page is written to the audit log.
swahili: Kufungua ukurasa huu kunaandikwa kwenye kumbukumbu za ukaguzi.

english: The checks have not run yet.

The page stops being public and stops taking money at once. Payments not yet sent are cancelled and every donor is refunded in full, whatever they chose. The case is then cancelled for fraud. This cannot be undone.
swahili: Ukurasa unaacha kuwa wa umma na kuacha kupokea pesa mara moja. Malipo ambayo hayajatumwa yanaghairiwa na kila mchangiaji anarudishiwa pesa zote, bila kujali alichochagua. Kesi kisha inaghairiwa kwa udanganyifu. Hili haliwezi kutenduliwa.

english: {{count}} of at least 10 characters (at most 300). The family may see a general reason.
swahili: Herufi {{count}} kati ya angalau 10 (zisizozidi 300). Familia inaweza kuona sababu ya jumla.

english: The case is frozen and refunds have started.
This case cannot be frozen from where it is.
swahili: Kesi hii haiwezi kusimamishwa ilipo sasa.

english: The case is not in a state where it can be paid.
swahili: Kesi haiko katika hali ya kulipwa.

english: The hospital has not confirmed a bill yet.
The hospital cannot receive payments yet.
The most that can be paid before the final bill has been reached.
swahili: Kiwango cha juu kinachoweza kulipwa kabla ya bili ya mwisho kimefikiwa.

english: There is no money available to pay out.
Not enough has been pledged yet for the next payment.
swahili: Hakuna pesa za kutosha zilizoahidiwa kwa malipo yanayofuata.

english: Ask about the money. It reads the books and can suggest a refund, a payment or a freeze, but it cannot do any of them: you approve or reject each suggestion.
swahili: Uliza kuhusu pesa. Husoma vitabu na anaweza kupendekeza marejesho, malipo au kusimamisha kesi, lakini hawezi kufanya lolote kati ya hayo: wewe unaidhinisha au kukataa kila pendekezo.

english: The treasurer agent is not switched on
An administrator can turn it on in the settings.
For example: which donations on this case are still unrefunded?
swahili: Kwa mfano: ni michango ipi kwenye kesi hii ambayo bado haijarudishwa?

english: The agent sees amounts, statuses and IDs only, never donor names, emails or bill text.
swahili: Msaidizi anaona kiasi, hali na vitambulisho pekee, kamwe si majina ya wachangiaji, barua pepe wala maandishi ya bili.

english: The agent ran out of steps before it finished. Try a narrower question.
swahili: Msaidizi alikosa hatua kabla ya kumaliza. Jaribu swali finyu zaidi.

english: When the agent proposes something it appears here.
No language model is set up in this environment, so the agent cannot answer.
swahili: Hakuna modeli ya lugha iliyowekwa kwenye mazingira haya, kwa hiyo msaidizi hawezi kujibu.

english: The language model could not be reached. Try again shortly.
swahili: Modeli ya lugha haikufikiwa. Jaribu tena baadaye kidogo.

english: Too many questions this hour. Please wait.
swahili: Maswali mengi sana saa hii. Tafadhali subiri.

english: The donor is refunded through PayPal straight away.
swahili: Mchangiaji anarudishiwa pesa kupitia PayPal mara moja.

english: A payment to the hospital is made straight away.
swahili: Malipo kwa hospitali yanafanywa mara moja.

english: The case is frozen and every donor is refunded.
swahili: Kesi inasimamishwa na kila mchangiaji anarudishiwa pesa.

english: Say why, so it is on record.
swahili: Sema kwa nini, ili iwe kwenye kumbukumbu.

english: It could not be carried out. See the reason on the card.
swahili: Haikuweza kufanyika. Angalia sababu kwenye kadi.
